floorCity.notes: Dalaran's streets are WMO 18950 (file 7116370) placed on MAP 0 over the Alterac crater (Alterac uiMap 1416, QuestieDB area 36); map 2980 'Dalaran City' holds the old Northrend nd_dalaran.wmo (115404, WMO id 5164) instead, so it is not this city. Routes in the city walk the WMO's own floor; the two lattice legs walk Alterac's ground to the south stairs' foot and the sewer outlet (Caves.floor); every portal, the airship and the glide are manual links.

notes: Dalaran stands on the Alterac ground (recheck2): WMO 18950's street floor (Caves.floor piece 0, z 40..139) comes down to the terrain by the south stairs (group 76 'Dalaran', outdoor, z 107 -> 81, then group 57 down a cliff to the ground at -38.1,169.4 z 56.7, faces to 41 deg) - on Alterac's main ground (reach.py: 7.3M sq yd, 100 yd from Alterac's road crossing to Hillsbrad at -92.9,95.8) - and by the sewer outlet north of the city (groups 61/65/77 'Cantrips & Crows', 'The Underbelly', 'Sewer' to group 78 at 391.0,535.7 z 41.0, on the same ground). voidBelow (85) is gone: the crater floor is real ground and the stairs land at 56.7.
